body:
Reviewed PR #28 "Plan bound envelope corrections in the existing receipt reader" (riatzukiza/foresight, base 1069d4c9 → head 920f1321) in full: all 4 pages of the immutable base/head diff (3 files, +176/−0), each hunk assessed.

Change: one new 160-line planning card (`docs/agile/kanban/receipt-envelope-correction-reader.md`), two appended decision receipts in `.ημ/receipts.edn`, and a 14-line append to `.ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md`. No executable code changes.

Deterministic evidence: all 13 gates exited 0 at the exact expected head — including `receipt_history` (261 records, 2 appended, base 1069d4c9 prefix preserved byte-for-byte) and `diff_hygiene`. The `workspace_laws` log contains `ENOENT` lines for absent `opencode`/`jscpd` tools; these are isolated-runner environment limitations, not change-introduced failures.

Verification performed: both new receipts were checked key-by-key against `foresight.evidence/receipt-envelope?`; the card's factual claims were checked against complete source (`receipt-envelope?` at `src/foresight/evidence.cljc:222`, `require-valid-receipt-records!` at `scripts/evidence.clj:226`, and its exactly three consumers `verify-receipts!`/`promotion-ready-at!`/`validate-held-receipt-ledger!`) and are accurate. Manual authoring of an `incoming` card with UUID and initial metadata is explicitly permitted first-class input per `docs/agile/AGENTS.md`; the UUID is unique; receipts live only under `.ημ/`.

Confirmed findings: none. No candidate survived adversarial validation, so this review yields no blocking or non-blocking defects.

Non-blocking notes: (1) no behavioral tests accompany this PR — correct for a planning-only change and honestly disclaimed in the PR body; the card's RED fixtures are prospective by design; (2) PR-body claims about PR27/PR22 contents, native review IDs, and suffix byte-count/SHA values are not independently verifiable from this checkout — they are documentary context, and the load-bearing prefix-preservation claim is gate-verified; (3) PR27's own failing gate remains separately open and is untouched by this PR, as the PR itself states.
